findings.title: Password recovery verification has two submit paths
findings.finding: The submitter first calls form.submit(), reaching onFinish/verify, and then calls submitButtonProps.onClick, calling verify again. pending is asynchronous. The focused L2 spec waits for one request but does not assert exact-one.

A GROUP assignment has no HEAD_COMPANY visibleDataNode fallback; resolveTaskScope rejects null or a prior REGION/PROJECT id. Existing L2 only covers generic GROUP users.
